Name: PlaylistButtonPlugin
Author: Jan
Description: GPIO button control for playlists: short print opens an overlay menu with all playlists (alphabetical, current ones marked) and scrolls through the list when pressed again briefly. After 10 seconds of inactivity, the overlay closes again without changing the active playlist. A long key press takes over the playlist marked in the menu as a new active playlist.

Services.description: Alphabetical list of all playlists, including the current selection and the active playlist
Permanently monitors the GPIO button and controls playlist changes via the Slideshow API.

AdvancedSettings.Label: Open Playlist Button
AdvancedSettings.Description: All settings: GPIO pin, press times, which playlists are listed, menu size, background colour and transparency, language. Also report a problem or buy Jan a coffee.

Actions.label: Show menu
Actions.description: Works like a short press of the button: opens the playlist menu, or moves the marker one line down if it is already open.

Permissions.reason: Displays the playlist selection menu as a text overlay.
Permanently monitors the GPIO button in the background.
Shows the plugin page with all settings, the issue link and the coffee button.
